data.narrative:
Primoco UAV is a publicly listed Defense & Security company founded by Ladislav Semetkovský. The valuation exercise draws from a comp universe of 21 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peer clustering. Specifically, only 1 same-stage comparable was identified; zero adjacent-stage and zero similar-tier peers met filter criteria. The Defense & Security sector lacks sufficient public defense-tech companies at Primoco's stage to support reliable median-multiple triangulation. Expanding to the full 21-peer Defense & Security set would introduce material heterogeneity and risk distorting valuation estimates across dissimilar business scales and technology maturity levels.

Absent sufficient peer density for multiples-based anchoring, alternative valuation approaches—such as discounted cash flow analysis, revenue-multiple analysis on fragmentary public data, or precedent M&A multiples—would be required to establish a defensible valuation range. The company's €44M+ orderbook provides a hard floor on operational traction but does not directly translate to enterprise value without visibility into margins, cash conversion, and growth trajectory. Key uncertainties include Defense & Security market consolidation trends, regulatory export restrictions on UAV technology, and the competitive positioning of larger legacy defense contractors.
